name: XMRbot Private Commerce
one_liner: A private agent that discovers, negotiates and acquires goods/services through XMR-native rails while exposing ordinary agent interfaces.
core_thesis: There is a distinct job where the user values separation between their normal identity/agent stack and the commerce transaction. XMR-native marketplaces and services can be wrapped behind a capability interface that handles discovery, negotiation, payment intent, escrow/proofs and delivery coordination without forcing the user to become Monero-native.
why_now: Agent commerce is expanding while XMR already provides mature private money and niche commerce infrastructure.
user: User/agent wanting private acquisition of legitimate goods or services
job: Obtain a good/service through a privacy-preserving agent workflow with bounded authority and proof of what happened.
distribution: ChatGPT/MCP adapter into XMR marketplaces and services.
moat: Marketplace adapter graph + escrow/proof abstractions + privacy-preserving workflow receipts.
falsifiers: Users prefer ordinary payment rails even for privacy-sensitive legitimate commerce.
Escrow/delivery proof cannot be standardized enough.

success_definition: All 12 checkpoints PROVEN on live evidence, with no unresolved critical H-task or security gate.

repo_binding.polling: GitHub snapshots are implementation evidence only; checkpoint proof comes from validator receipts.

software_substitution_test.counterfactual: OpenAI/platform vendors ship perfect software for every reproducible feature in this project tomorrow.
software_substitution_test.rationale: The adapter is trivial. A trusted graph of merchants, completed private transactions, escrow behavior and settlement access is not.

underengineer.rule: Choose the earliest real-world event that increases controlled scarce state; build only its prerequisites plus safety and verification.
underengineer.scarce_state_target: Complete one useful private-commerce transaction through one rail
underengineer.minimal_live_product: Use one marketplace/service only: search a legitimate item/service, normalize offer, communicate/possibly negotiate, require human approval/signing for payment, and record escrow/settlement/delivery outcome.

steps.action: Resolve one real request against one XMR marketplace/service
steps.acceptance: Offer provenance and merchant identity reference exist.

steps.action: Send one bounded marketplace message if needed

steps.acceptance: Payment proof maps to intent; worker never sees wallet secret.
Merchant and transaction graph gain one verified edge.

underengineer.graduation_rule: Repeated legitimate transactions with recurring merchants produce useful private reputation/outcome data.
underengineer.kill_or_rethink_rule: If no recurring commerce relationship forms and users only need generic wallet actions, the standalone product has weak moat.
underengineer.project_manager_invariant: A feature may enter NOW only if it is necessary to reach the first real moat event, required for safety/verification, or empirically unblocks that path.
underengineer.observation_pause: After the first live moat event, stop expanding and inspect customer/outcome evidence before choosing the next feature.

full_roadmap_policy: The original checkpoint ladder is a capability library, not default build order. UNDERENGINEER chooses the live minimum path.
